messages:
elaine: Hey @jun @matt — prepping a live demo + webinar next Wed. Need a concise bench package we can cite on a slide and a fuller run for the webinar writeup. Specifically: methodology blurb, sample payloads (short + long), quick Friday smoke rerun, and full Monday sweep. Can you own? :pray:
jun: Ack. Quick Qs: which model variant (fp16 / 8bit quant) do you want pinned, and what latency SLOs should I aim for? Also which region/hardware to run on?
matt: For the demo I'd recommend quant-8 (v2.3-quant) so numbers are conservative. Target SLOs: p95 <= 150ms, p50 <= 50ms. Hardware: us-west g4dn-like for demo parity with hosted. Sound good?
elaine: Yes — quant-8 v2.3 is perfect. We need both cold-start and steady-state (after warmup). Also a token-cost breakout (per-token $ estimate) so marketing can show unit economics. For slide copy we want a one-paragraph methodology note saying how runs were done (warmup, concurrency, batch, seed).
sarah: I can assemble the sample prompts + a short README for marketing. Elaine — send the prompt list you want.
elaine: Putting sample prompts here (short then long):
```
# short (for demo slides, 5x)
1) "Summarize in one sentence: Redwood Inference value prop."
2) "List three benefits of private deployment."
3) "Short product pitch for devs (20 words)."
4) "Example error message handling best-practice."
5) "One-line onboarding checklist for SDK."

# long (for webinar deep dive, 3x)
1) "You are an engineer evaluating inference platforms. Compare Redwood Inference to a managed cloud endpoint across latency, cost, and operational risk (3 paragraphs)."
2) "Describe a rollout plan for a model update with canary + automatic fallback policies, include metrics to monitor."
3) "Explain cache + batching tradeoffs when serving mixed short/long workloads with example configs."
```
elaine: Also please include sample `curl` snippets we can paste in the deck for reproducibility.
jun: Plan: concurrency=4, batch_size=8, warmup=20 requests (cleared cache between measured runs), deterministic seed for sampling, run on us-west g4dn-equivalent. We'll capture p50/p90/p95/p99, tokens/sec, cpu/gpu utilization, and per-token cost estimate. I'll do a Friday smoke (subset above) and a Monday full sweep with cached vs uncached variants.
matt: Important — prefix/KV cache will materially affect short prompt latencies. We should include both: "fresh cache" and "hot cache" numbers and call that out in the methodology blurb. Also include quantization variant notes (which kernels/flags we used).
elaine: Great — hot vs cold cache distinction is exactly what marketing wants. Can you make the methodology blurb 2-3 sentences so it fits a slide?
jun: Yep. Draft blurb will be: "Runs executed on g4dn-equivalent with v2.3-quant (8-bit). Each configuration was warmed with 20 requests before measurements; cache-cleared runs measure cold-start; separate runs capture hot-cache steady-state. Metrics: p50/p95 latency, throughput (tokens/s), and per-token cost estimate."
sarah: Packaging the sample payloads now and will upload to the marketing S3 bucket after the smoke run. I'll include the `curl` examples Elaine asked for.
perf-bot: perf-bot: bench run scheduled by jun — run-id run-1747654328-demo-smoke. ETA: 10m.
jun: Quick smoke results (small set, short prompts) pasted below — these are rough numbers for slide sanity only:
```
variant: v2.3-quant (8-bit), hw: us-west g4dn-equivalent
fresh-cache: p50=60ms, p95=180ms, tokens/s=220, est $/1k tokens = $0.09
hot-cache: p50=28ms, p95=85ms, tokens/s=420, est $/1k tokens = $0.06
notes: concurrency=4, batch=8, warmup=20, sample size=200 requests
```
matt: Those hot-cache numbers look solid for the demo. For the webinar deep-dive we'll need larger sample sizes and the quantization kernel notes (I can add the exact lib/flag list).
elaine: This is awesome, thanks. Timeline check — can we have Friday smoke artifacts + README (for slide copy) and full sweep results + raw artifacts by Monday EOD?
jun: Yes — smoke artifacts up in S3 in ~15m, full sweep scheduled Mon morning. I'll paste the exact `curl` commands and run config in the run notes.
sarah: Uploaded sample payloads and smoke artifacts to s3://marketing-artifacts/demo-1747654321/ — I'll DM links. README included.
perf-bot: perf-bot: smoke run complete. artifacts: s3://marketing-artifacts/demo-1747654321/run-1747654328/summary.json
elaine: Perfect. Once the full sweep finishes can you also include the latency histogram PNG so the design team can make a small chart?
jun: Will do. I'll circle back here with the run-id and the histogram link when the full sweep is done.
matt: I'll add quantization notes to the run metadata and a one-liner about kernel fallbacks for the methodology.
elaine: Thank you all — huge help. I'll draft the slide copy once I have the README and blurb. :rocket:
